framework.name: Next.js
framework.rendering_strategy: Predominantly Client-Side Rendered (CSR) via 'use client' directives with SSR shell

routing.middleware: None (no middleware.ts in frontend; route guarding is handled client-side in useEffect / AppShell)

state_management.stores: No external store libraries (no Redux, Zustand, Recoil, or MobX)
state_management.component_state: useState, useReducer, useCallback, useMemo across individual pages

api_client.underlying_transport: Native window.fetch with automatic Bearer token injection and CSRF header propagation
api_client.token_refresh: Automatic 401 interception with queue-based concurrent refresh via /api/v1/auth/refresh

authentication.oauth_flow: Google OAuth 2.0 PKCE / Authorization Code via /api/v1/auth/google/callback
authentication.session_invalidation: CustomEvent dispatch ('lcc:session-expired') and tab session clearing

form_validation.approach: Inline client-side validation using standard HTML5 constraints and manual regex checks
form_validation.schema_validation: Zod is in node_modules, but forms rely primarily on manual checks (e.g. regex for OTP, required string trims)

error_handling.ui_representation: Inline error banners, alerts, toast notifications, ErrorState component

testing.runner: Puppeteer E2E automated browser integration scripts
testing.unit_tests: No Jest or Vitest test suites configured in package.json (no .test.tsx or .spec.tsx files)
